INVOKER-SCROLL.title: Scroll
INVOKER-SCROLL.description: This spell is inscribed onto a Scroll. You may only carry 2 [gold]Scrolls[/gold] at once; when a 3rd is created, the oldest is [gold]Exhausted[/gold]. [gold]Retain[/gold]: not discarded at end of turn.
INVOKER-INVOKE.title: Invoke
INVOKER-INVOKE.description: Read the current orb lineup (Q W E) and generate the matching spell card.
INVOKER-QUAS.title: Quas
INVOKER-QUAS.description: Ice Soul orb. When channeled, grants Block. The more Quas orbs you have, the stronger ice spells become.
INVOKER-WEX.title: Wex
INVOKER-WEX.description: Storm Soul orb. When channeled, deals damage to a random enemy. Fuels speed and lightning spells.
INVOKER-EXORT.title: Exort
INVOKER-EXORT.description: Fire Soul orb. When channeled, deals damage to all enemies. Powers devastating fire spells.
